title: simpler textures
description: makes textures simpler to optimize pvp
body: Simpler Textures is a PvP-focused resource pack designed to improve gameplay clarity by reducing visual clutter and simplifying the textures of commonly used items such as swords, axes, tools, armor, and inventory elements. The pack features clean, minimalistic designs that make items easier to recognize during fast-paced combat, along with a consistent style that keeps the game visually smooth and distraction-free. By removing unnecessary detail and enhancing item visibility, Simpler Textures helps players react faster, track their inventory more efficiently, and stay focused during fights. This resource pack is ideal for players who want a cleaner look without changing core gameplay mechanics, as it only modifies textures and does not provide any unfair advantages.:::
